verdict.rationale: The evidence shows a REST API, SDKs and a changelog that lists additions such as new endpoints and fields. Nothing documents API versioning (no version scheme or version headers) or a deprecation policy (no sunset timelines or breaking-change notice). A changelog of additive changes is an adjacent feature, not a versioning or deprecation guarantee, so this applicable axis has no supporting evidence.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
